why_the_term_was_the_wrong_instrument: A LOOP_INDUCTION term's stride is ALSO the address advance -- the tensor-view record carries a separate edge-mask field for exactly this reason, and says so.  Moving the term to the context loop clamps the axis AND moves the base with it.  Measured: it made the ratio-2 join pass and changed the reduced vehicle's PREFILL token from 1126 to 2284, because the operand then read different memory.  The edge mask clamps without advancing, which is the only one of the two meanings this operand needs.
